kiosk.subtitle: Gate attendance · Sheet Shapers
kiosk.help: Need help? Ask the plant office.

pairing.title: Pair this device
pairing.instruction: Type the 6-digit code from the admin screen: Attendance devices › Add device.
pairing.filledFromLink: Code filled in from the link.
pairing.wrongCode: This code is not right. Type it again.
pairing.locationText: It proves this device is at the plant gate. When the browser asks, press Allow.
pairing.accuracyNow: accuracy now · needs ± {{metres}} m or better · waits up to 20 s

paired.title: Paired
paired.later: Attendance starts in a later update. Keep this screen open; the admin can see it is online.

code-expired.title: Code expired
code-expired.message: This code has expired. Ask the admin for a new code.
steps: On the admin screen, press “Make a new code”.
Type the new code here within 10 minutes.

locked.title: Too many tries
locked.message: Too many tries. Ask the admin for a new code.
steps: The old code does not work any more.
Ask the admin to make a new code, then type it here.

location-off.title: Location is off
location-off.message: Turn on location on this device and allow it for this site, then try again.
steps: Turn on Location in the phone or Windows settings.
When the browser asks, press “Allow”.

gps-weak.title: Location not accurate enough
gps-weak.message: The device cannot find its place well enough. Turn on Wi‑Fi or move near a window, then try again.
steps: Turn on Wi‑Fi. It does not need to connect to a network.
Move the device near a window or the open gate.
Press “Try again”.

outside.title: Not at the plant
outside.message: This device is not at the plant.
steps: Take this device to the plant gate.
Press “Try again” there.
Already at the gate? Ask the admin to check the plant boundary.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.message: Open this page in the latest Chrome or Edge.
steps: Open Chrome or Edge on this device (update it if it asks).
Open the attendance page again.
Use the site address that starts with https.

revoked.title: Switched off
revoked.message: This device has been switched off by the admin.
steps: To use it again, the admin adds it as a new attendance device.
Then type the new code on this device.

network.title: No connection
network.message: The internet is not reachable. Check the connection and try again.
steps: Check that the device is online.
Press “Try again”.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: Pairing did not work. Try again, or ask the admin for help.
steps: Press “Try again”.
If it keeps failing, tell the admin the code below.

QR_REVOKED.title: NOT ACCEPTED
QR_REVOKED.voice: Card blocked. Please visit the plant office.

QR_EXPIRED.title: NOT ACCEPTED
QR_EXPIRED.voice: Card expired. Please visit the plant office.

QR_NOT_YET_VALID.title: NOT ACCEPTED
QR_NOT_YET_VALID.message: This card is not active yet.
QR_NOT_YET_VALID.voice: Card not active yet. Please visit the plant office.

WRONG_PLANT.title: NOT ACCEPTED
WRONG_PLANT.message: This card is for another plant.
WRONG_PLANT.voice: Card for another plant. Please visit the plant office.

EMPLOYEE_NOT_QR.title: NOT ACCEPTED
EMPLOYEE_NOT_QR.message: This card cannot be used for punching.
EMPLOYEE_NOT_QR.voice: Card cannot be used. Please visit the plant office.

EMPLOYEE_INACTIVE.title: NOT ACCEPTED
EMPLOYEE_INACTIVE.voice: Card cannot be used. Please visit the plant office.

QR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: NOT ACCEPTED
QR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.voice: Card not valid. Please visit the plant office.

QR_FORMAT_INVALID.title: TRY AGAIN
QR_FORMAT_INVALID.message: The card could not be read.
QR_FORMAT_INVALID.next: Hold it still, about 20 cm from the camera.
QR_FORMAT_INVALID.voice: Card not read. Please try again.

SNAPSHOT_MISSING.title: TRY AGAIN
SNAPSHOT_MISSING.message: The photo could not be taken.
SNAPSHOT_MISSING.next: Stand in front of the camera and try again.
SNAPSHOT_MISSING.voice: Photo not taken. Please try again.

SNAPSHOT_INVALID.title: TRY AGAIN
SNAPSHOT_INVALID.message: The photo could not be taken.
SNAPSHOT_INVALID.next: Stand in front of the camera and try again.
SNAPSHOT_INVALID.voice: Photo not taken. Please try again.

QR_SIGNING_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: NOT ACCEPTED
QR_SIGNING_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: This attendance device cannot read cards yet.
QR_SIGNING_NOT_CONFIGURED.voice: Cards cannot be read yet. Please visit the plant office.

NETWORK_OFFLINE.title: NOT SAVED
NETWORK_OFFLINE.message: No internet. Your punch was NOT saved.

SERVER_NO_ANSWER.title: NOT SURE
SERVER_NO_ANSWER.message: The server did not answer in time.
SERVER_NO_ANSWER.next: Scan your card again. If it was saved, you will see it.
SERVER_NO_ANSWER.voice: Not sure if saved. Please scan again.

INTERNAL_ERROR.title: ERROR
INTERNAL_ERROR.next: Try again. If it repeats, please visit the plant office.
INTERNAL_ERROR.voice: Something went wrong. Please try again.

TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.title: PLEASE WAIT
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.next: Wait a moment, then try again.
TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.voice: Not saved. Please wait and try again.

CAMERA_BLOCKED.title: Camera is blocked
CAMERA_BLOCKED.message: Allow the camera for this site.
steps: Tap the padlock or camera icon next to the web address.
Set Camera to “Allow”.
Press “Try again”.

CAMERA_NOT_FOUND.title: No camera found
steps: Check that the camera is plugged in.
Close other apps that use the camera.

BROWSER_NOT_SUPPORTED.title: This browser cannot read cards
BROWSER_NOT_SUPPORTED.message: Open this page in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
steps: Install or update Chrome or Edge.
Open the attendance page again.

face.title: Face recognition
face.description: Matching limits, chosen after the accuracy tests.

salary.title: Salary estimate
salary.description: Used only for the salary estimate.

kiosk_screen.title: Device sound and screen
kiosk_screen.description: What every gate attendance device plays and how long it shows a result.

gps_accuracy_limit_m.label: GPS accuracy limit
gps_accuracy_limit_m.help: A device must report its location at least this precisely to pair.

geofence_default_buffer_m.label: Default geofence margin
geofence_default_buffer_m.help: Extra metres around a drawn geofence, so GPS jitter at the edge does not refuse a device.

pairing_code_minutes.label: Pairing code life
pairing_code_minutes.help: How long an attendance device pairing code works.

session_idle_minutes.label: Log out after being idle
session_idle_minutes.help: A user who does nothing for this long must log in again.

session_max_hours.label: Longest login
session_max_hours.help: After this many hours everyone must log in again.

login_max_failures.label: Wrong passwords before lock
login_max_failures.help: After this many wrong passwords the account is locked for a while.

login_lock_minutes.label: Lock time
login_lock_minutes.help: How long a locked account stays locked.

punch_cooldown_minutes.label: Punch cool-down
punch_cooldown_minutes.help: A second punch by the same person within this time is refused.

snapshot_retention_days.label: Snapshot retention
snapshot_retention_days.help: QR-punch photos are deleted after this many days.

face_match_threshold.label: Face match threshold
face_match_threshold.help: How similar a face must be to count as a match.

face_match_margin.label: Face match margin
face_match_margin.help: How much better the best match must be than the second best.

impossible_travel_kmh.label: Impossible travel speed
impossible_travel_kmh.help: Punches at two plants that would need a faster trip are flagged.

salary_day_basis.label: Salary day basis
salary_day_basis.help: Days used to work out the per-day salary (26, 30 or actual days).

min_minutes_before_out.label: Earliest OUT after IN
min_minutes_before_out.help: A scan this soon after an IN is refused as “Already IN”, so a double scan never closes the day by mistake.

open_in_max_hours.label: Longest open IN
open_in_max_hours.help: If the last IN is older than this, the next scan is a new IN and the old day stays incomplete. 20 hours covers a 12-hour night shift.

snapshot_dark_threshold.label: Dark photo limit
snapshot_dark_threshold.help: A photo whose average brightness is below this gets the Dark photo mark in the punch log. The punch itself is decided as normal.

qr_card_default_validity_months.label: Default card validity
qr_card_default_validity_months.help: The end date suggested when a card is issued. The Super Admin can still pick another date.

qr_card_expiring_soon_days.label: “Ends soon” warning
qr_card_expiring_soon_days.help: Cards that end within this many days show “Ends soon” and are counted on the dashboard.

kiosk_voice_enabled.label: Voice
kiosk_voice_enabled.help: The attendance device says “Checked in”, “Checked out” or the reason, in English. The name is never spoken.

kiosk_sound_enabled.label: Sounds
kiosk_sound_enabled.help: Short tones: two rising notes when accepted, one soft note for already punched, two low notes when rejected.

kiosk_result_seconds.label: Result screen time
kiosk_result_seconds.help: How long an accepted result stays on the attendance device screen before it is ready for the next person.

kiosk_reject_seconds.label: Rejected screen time
kiosk_reject_seconds.help: Rejections stay longer, so the worker can read what to do next.

kiosk_photo_ready_seconds.label: Time to get ready for the photo
kiosk_photo_ready_seconds.help: After a card is read, the worker gets this long to look at the camera (and switch the camera) before the photo is taken. Tapping "I'm ready" takes it sooner.

retentionWarning.title: Lowering to {{days}} days also shortens the photos already stored.

template.required: Required columns: employee_code, full_name, type, plant_code, category, shift and joined_on (DD/MM/YYYY).

drop.title: Drop the Excel file here, or press to choose
drop.text: .xlsx only, up to 2 MB and 2,000 rows.

errors.notExcel: This is not an Excel (.xlsx) file.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.

report.allOrNothingText: Nothing is saved until the file has zero errors. Fix the rows in Excel and choose the file again.
report.moreErrors: {{count}} more errors are not shown. Fix these first.
report.clean: The file is clean. Press the button to save all the rows.
report.cleanApproval: The file is clean. Press the button to send it for approval.

done.createdText: The people are in the system now.
done.sentText: The Super Admin will check the import. Nobody is added before that.

codes.PLANT_NOT_FOUND: This plant code does not exist.
codes.EMPLOYEE_CODE_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: This employee code appears twice in the file.
codes.EMPLOYEE_CODE_EXISTS: This employee code is already used.
codes.HOURLY_RATE_REQUIRED: A temporary worker needs an hourly rate.
codes.IMPORT_CELL_FORMULA: This cell starts with = + - or @. Type plain text.

qrCards.title: QR cards
qrCards.subtitle: Issue, print and revoke the QR ID cards of the workers who punch by card. A card works only at the person's own plant.

readOnlyBanner.text: Only the Super Admin issues, prints and revokes cards, because a printed card works like a key to the gate. If a card is lost or a worker needs one, ask the Super Admin.

qrCards.searchPlaceholder: Search code, name or card serial
qrCards.empty: No cards yet. Select employees and press Issue cards.
qrCards.emptyHelp: There are no employees to show yet. Add or import employees first, then come back here.

panel.title: QR card
panel.noneHelp: This employee has no QR card. Issue one so they can punch at the gate.
panel.faceNote: This employee punches by face, so no QR card is needed. A QR card is only for employees who punch by QR card.
panel.leftNote: This employee has left, so no card can be issued.

faceSwitched.title: Revoke this card: the attendance device rejects it now.
faceSwitched.text: {{name}} now punches by face. The card is not revoked automatically. Until you revoke it, the attendance device rejects it.

reprint.title: Reprint advised.
reprint.text: This card shows {{printed}}, but the employee now works at {{current}}. The card still works; print a new copy so the plant on it is right.

issue.title: Issue a new QR card
issue.replaceTitle: The current card {{serial}} will stop working at once.
issue.replaceText: It is recorded as revoked with the reason “Replaced by” and the new card's serial. Take the old card back if you can.
issue.validFromHint: Today, or up to {{days}} days ahead.
issue.validUntilHint_one: Default: {{months}} month. At most 3 years after the start.
issue.validUntilHint_other: Default: {{months}} months. At most 3 years after the start.
issue.notePlaceholder: For example: old card was damaged
issue.doneText: Valid {{from}} to {{until}}. Print it and hand it to the worker yourself.

revoke.title: Revoke card {{serial}}
revoke.warning: The card stops working at every gate immediately. This cannot be undone: issue a new card instead.

changeEnd.title: Change the end date
changeEnd.hint: “End today” keeps the card working until the end of today. To stop it at once, revoke it.

bulk.tooMany: Select at most {{max}} people for this action.
bulk.hintTitle: What each button will do with these {{count}} people

hint.issue: {{ok}} get a new card, {{skipped}} are skipped (they already have a card or punch by face).
hint.print: {{ok}} of {{total}} have a card to print.
hint.revoke: {{ok}} cards that are not revoked yet.

bulk.skippedNote_one: {{count}} person was skipped. Nothing was changed for them.
bulk.skippedNote_other: {{count}} people were skipped. Nothing was changed for them.
bulk.printInParts: A PDF holds at most {{max}} cards, so the new cards are printed in parts.

issue.description: Only people who punch by QR card and have no card yet get one. The others are skipped, not failed.
issue.resultText: They are ready to print. Print them and hand each card to the worker yourself.

revoke.description: Of the {{total}} people you selected, {{skipped}} are skipped because they have no card or it is already revoked.
revoke.resultText: The cards stop working at every gate immediately.

print.description: Each card shows the person's current plant.
print.leftOut_one: {{count}} selected person is left out: no card, or the card is revoked.
print.leftOut_other: {{count}} selected people are left out: no card, or the card is revoked.

a4_sheet.title: A4 sheets of 10
a4_sheet.text: 2 cards across, 5 down, with cut marks. Best for many cards.

single_cards.title: One card per page
single_cards.text: Card size 85.6 × 54 mm, one page each. For a card printer.

print.note: The PDF opens in a new tab. Print it from there. Every print is counted and written to the audit log; the file is not saved on the server.
print.tooManyTip: Print at most {{max}} cards at a time. Filter by plant or contractor, select that group, print it, then do the next group.

test.newText: A test card is scanned at a gate attendance device to check that it works. It belongs to nobody and never makes attendance.
test.label: Label
test.labelHint: Say where it is used, for example “Gate test K134”.
test.explain: A guard scans a test card at the gate attendance device each morning. The device shows “Device OK” and nothing is recorded as attendance.
test.empty: No test cards yet. Create one to check a gate attendance device.

afterImport.title: Next step: ID cards
afterImport.text: {{qr}} of these people punch by QR card and have no card yet. {{face}} punch by face and are left out.
afterImport.button_one: Issue and print the card for this employee
afterImport.button_other: Issue and print cards for these {{count}} employees
afterImport.dialogText: All of them punch by QR card and have no card yet.
afterImport.defaultReason: New workers from the Excel import of {{date}}
afterImport.printNote: After issuing you can print the cards, in parts of at most {{max}}. Cards can be printed later too.
afterImport.issuedText: Print the cards now. You can also print later from the QR cards page: filter by Not printed.
afterImport.onlySuperAdmin: Only the Super Admin issues and prints QR cards.
afterImport.sentNote: After the Super Admin approves, the Super Admin issues and prints the cards. You cannot issue cards.
afterImport.noQr_one: No QR card is needed for this file. The one person punches by face. There is nobody to issue a card to.
afterImport.noQr_other: No QR cards are needed for this file. All {{count}} people punch by face. There is nobody to issue a card to.

punchReasons.QR_FORMAT_INVALID: The card could not be read

punches.title: Punch log
punches.description: Every card punch at the gate attendance devices, accepted or rejected. Times in IST.
punches.descriptionOwnPlant: Every card punch at your plant's gate, accepted or rejected. Times in IST.
punches.readOnlyPlantHead: Read-only, your plant only. Only the Super Admin can open punch photos; here you see whether a photo was saved.
punches.readOnlyCorporateHead: Read-only. Only the Super Admin can open punch photos; here you see whether a photo was saved.
punches.empty: No punches yet today at this plant.

summary.label: Totals of the day
summary.hint: Press a number to show only those punches

filter.search: Search by employee code or name

photo.title: Punch photo
photo.audited: Viewing is recorded in the audit log.
photo.purged: This photo was deleted after the retention period.
photo.notAvailable: No photo is available for this punch.
photo.storageDown: The photo store cannot be reached. Try again later.

compare.title: Compare photos
compare.explain: This punch next to the last 3 stored photos of the same card, newest first. Look for a different person using the same card.
compare.none: This card has no earlier stored photos.
compare.failed: The comparison could not be loaded. Try again.
compare.audited_one: {{count}} photo shown. Each photo shown is recorded in the audit log.
compare.audited_other: {{count}} photos shown. Each photo shown is recorded in the audit log.

notices.title: Gate notices
notices.description: Short messages shown on the gate attendance device screen. Workers see them while they punch.
notices.readOnlyCorporateHead: Read-only. Only the Super Admin and the Plant Head of a plant write notices.
notices.plantHeadNote: You write notices for your own plant. Notices for all plants are written by the Super Admin; you can read them but not change them.
notices.empty: No gate notices yet. Press New notice to write one.

end.title: End this notice now?
end.explain: The notice disappears from the gate screens within a minute. It stays in this list as Ended.

form.explain: Workers see it on the gate screen while they punch.
form.textHint: One line of plain text, shown exactly as typed, to everyone at the gate. Do not write names, employee codes, phone numbers, pay or health details.
form.importantHint: Shown first, in amber, with the word Important.
form.datesHint: Times are IST. At most {{days}} days after the start. The notice disappears by itself at the end.
form.preview: How it looks at the gate
form.previewEmpty: Your notice appears here as you type.
form.previewNote: Live preview of the notices panel of the gate screen ({{where}}).
form.within: Attendance devices show it within 2 minutes after saving.

error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
error.tooLong: A notice can show for at most 90 days.
